exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'No sooner … than'. Choose the correct form.

questions.question: She read the telegram. She fainted at once. Combine using 'No sooner … than'.
options: No sooner did she read the telegram than she fainted
No sooner she did read the telegram than she fainted
No sooner did she read the telegram then she fainted
questions.answer: No sooner did she read the telegram than she fainted
questions.explanation: Use 'did + V1' because both actions are in the simple past. The auxiliary 'did' comes before the subject. Use 'than' not 'then'. 'No sooner' နောက်မှာ auxiliary verb ကို subject ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: The thieves saw the police. They ran away at once. Combine using 'No sooner … than'.
options: No sooner did the thieves see the police than they ran away
No sooner did the thieves see the police then they ran away
No sooner the thieves did see the police than they ran away
questions.answer: No sooner did the thieves see the police than they ran away
questions.explanation: Both actions are simple past, so use 'did + V1'. The auxiliary comes before the subject. 'than' is the correct connector. Simple past နှစ်ခုလုံးအတွက် 'did + V1' သုံးပါ။

questions.question: The teacher had entered the class. The students kept quiet at once. Combine using 'No sooner … than'.
options: No sooner had the teacher entered the class than the students kept quiet
No sooner did the teacher enter the class than the students kept quiet
No sooner had the teacher entered the class then the students kept quiet
questions.answer: No sooner had the teacher entered the class than the students kept quiet
questions.explanation: The first action uses past perfect ('had entered'), so use 'had + V3'. The second action is simple past. Use 'than' not 'then'. Past perfect ပထမ action မှာ ရှိတဲ့အတွက် 'had + V3' သုံးပါ။
